financingDealsWithoutParsedInvestors.description: Pudu Robotics announced it raised nearly $150 million, exceeding a $1.5 billion valuation and bringing cumulative funding above $300 million, to accelerate embodied AI, product expansion, manufacturing capacity, and global deployment.
Physical Intelligence was reported to be discussing a roughly $1 billion round at an approximately $11 billion valuation.
Pony.ai priced its U.S. IPO raising approximately $260 million in primary and secondary proceeds at a $4.5 billion valuation.
Gatik raised a Series B extension to expand middle-mile autonomous trucking operations across retail and grocery customers.
Kepler Robotics reported approximately $100 million in financing to scale Forerunner K2 humanoid production.
UBTECH reported 2024 results and progress on Walker S humanoid pilots at NIO, BYD, Foxconn, and Geely.
Deep Robotics reported approximately 700M RMB Series B-plus financing to scale quadruped manufacturing and humanoid R&D.
AutoStore listed on Oslo Børs at an initial market capitalization of approximately $12.4 billion; AUTO.OL.
Mobileye reported FY2024 revenue of approximately $1.65 billion and reaffirmed ADAS / robotaxi roadmap including Chauffeur and Drive.
Cerebras Systems filed S-1 with the SEC for a proposed NASDAQ IPO; offering remains pending CFIUS review.
Luminar reported FY2024 revenue of approximately $75 million and reaffirmed Halo next-generation LIDAR for series production at $500-700 ASP.
Aeva reported FY2024 revenue and confirmed Daimler Truck and Torc Robotics FMCW LIDAR design win for autonomous trucking.
Hesai Technology reported 2023 revenue of approximately $250 million; remained the global LIDAR shipment leader by units.
Vicarious Surgical reported continued cash runway and FDA Investigational Device Exemption progress for ventral-hernia surgical robot.
Knightscope reported FY2024 results with autonomous security robotics fleet continuing to grow at law-enforcement and commercial-real-estate sites.
